safety.title: Safety
safety.noModsBody: Manual play only. No third-party software is ever installed on your account.
safety.discordBody: Real people on the other end, not a canned-response bot.
safety.sharingBody: Your password isn't asked for at checkout — it's submitted only after payment, through a separate secure form, encrypted with AES-256, and deleted as soon as the order closes.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How long does an order take?
faq.a1: Most orders start within minutes of payment; the exact time depends on the delivery speed you pick.
faq.q2: Is it safe for my account?
faq.a2: We only use manual play from verified executors — no third-party software or modifications are ever installed on your account.
faq.a3: No, checkout never asks for it. If a specific service needs it, you submit it separately after payment through a secure form.
faq.a4: Payment goes through CryptoBot — it supports all major cryptocurrencies; the full list is shown at the payment step.
faq.q5: What if the code doesn't arrive?
faq.a5: That's rare and usually a payment-confirmation delay. Message support or Discord and we'll check the status by hand.
faq.a6: Refunds follow the Refund policy if an order wasn't fulfilled. Message support with your order number.

safety.heading: How we keep accounts safe
safety.body: No third-party software is injected into your game client. Progress is earned through ordinary gameplay performed by an experienced player, which is why we have no suspension reports on file. Safety status is reviewed and republished every 72 hours.

codes.heading: Where the codes come from
codes.body: All digital codes are sourced from authorised regional distributors and are resold in an unredeemed state. Each code is delivered exactly once: our warehouse marks it as sold at the moment of delivery, so it cannot be issued to two customers.

payments.heading: Payments
payments.body: Payments are processed in cryptocurrency by CryptoBot Pay. We never see or store card data. An order is only fulfilled after a cryptographically signed payment confirmation.

credentials.heading: Your credentials
credentials.body: For piloted services we ask for account access only after payment, inside your order card. Secrets are encrypted with AES-256 and erased automatically the moment the order is marked complete.

dashboard.credentialsNotice: Encrypted with AES-256 and erased automatically once your order is completed.

faq.a1: Codes are instant. Boosts start as soon as an executor claims your order.
faq.q2: Do I have to share my password?

faq.a3: Crypto only, processed by CryptoBot Pay.
faq.a4: Unredeemed codes and unstarted services are refundable — see the refund policy.

whoWeAre.heading: Who we are
whoWeAre.body: Neondrive is an independent community platform for digital codes and co-op gameplay services for GTA V / GTA Online. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

eligibility.heading: Eligibility
eligibility.body: You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your jurisdiction, to place an order. By ordering you confirm you meet that requirement and that your use complies with the laws that apply to you.

ordersPayment.heading: Orders & payment
ordersPayment.body: Prices are listed in USD. We accept payment in BTC, ETH, USDT, and TON only — there is no card or bank payment option. An order is confirmed once payment is verified on-chain.

coopRisk.heading: Co-op & boost services
coopRisk.body: Some services involve a team member playing on your account, either with your account credentials or in a joint session. Sharing account access is against Rockstar/Take-Two's own terms of service and can result in a suspension or ban of your account — that risk is yours to accept, independently of anything we do. Never share credentials you're not comfortable risking.

prohibitedUse.heading: Prohibited use
prohibitedUse.body: You may not use this site for fraud, chargebacks after a completed order, or to resell our codes or services commercially without our written permission. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order we reasonably suspect involves prohibited use.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: Services are provided as-is. We apply the security measures described in our Privacy Policy, but can't guarantee the state of your game account once a third party has played on it. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the affected order.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
whatWeCollect.body: Your email or Discord ID (for sign-in), your locale, the contact handle (Telegram/WhatsApp/Discord) you provide at checkout, and your order history. We don't ask for or store a password for the site itself — sign-in is passwordless.

credentialsHandling.heading: Game account credentials
credentialsHandling.body: If you choose to share game account credentials for a co-op/boost order, they're encrypted immediately and only visible, decrypted, to the staff member assigned to that specific order. They're permanently deleted the moment the order is marked complete, and never included in our internal spreadsheets or team chat.

howWeUseData.heading: How we use your data
howWeUseData.body: To fulfil your order, contact you about it, and improve the service. We don't sell your personal data, and we don't use it for advertising.

sheetsSync.heading: Internal record-keeping
sheetsSync.body: Order metadata — product, platform, amount, status, and your contact handle — is synced to an internal spreadsheet for operations and accounting. Game account passwords are never included in that sync.

dataRetention.heading: Data retention
dataRetention.body: We keep order records for as long as needed for accounting and support purposes. You can ask us to delete your account and associated personal data at any time, subject to records we're required to keep by law.

yourRights.heading: Your rights
yourRights.body: You can ask to see, correct, or delete the personal data we hold about you by contacting support on Discord.

digitalCodes.heading: Digital codes
digitalCodes.body: A code that hasn't been revealed yet is fully refundable if it wasn't delivered as described. Once you click "Show Code", the order is final — that's the point the code becomes yours.

coopServices.heading: Co-op & boost services
coopServices.body: Full refund if your order is still unclaimed in the queue. Once a team member has claimed and started the job, refunds are handled case by case depending on how much work was completed — contact support and we'll sort it out fairly.

howToRequest.heading: How to request a refund
howToRequest.body: Open a ticket in our Discord support server with your order ID. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

paymentMethod.heading: How refunds are paid
paymentMethod.body: Refunds are sent in the same cryptocurrency you paid with, to a wallet address you provide.

disputes.heading: Before opening a dispute
disputes.body: Please contact support first — most issues are resolved faster that way than through a payment processor dispute, and it helps us actually fix the problem.
